display.name: 加速卡资源
display.description: 统一核心图表；来源特有指标列于专属诊断。单位见标题，统计差异见图表提示。

display.name: 加速卡显存占用比例（%）
display.description: 指标：node_xpu_memutil，单位：%。按节点与卡号 devid 展示瞬时观测。直接使用 exporter 的百分数，不再次乘以 100。每 5 秒采集，默认每 15 秒刷新。有效零值保留；负值、缺样、超过 15 秒的采样和失败抓取留空。超过 100% 的值留空。新鲜度依据抓取时间，exporter 未提供独立设备观测时间。

spec.query: ((node_xpu_memutil{environment="xpu-pd",job="xpu-hardware",node=~"$node",devid=~"$device",node=~"$role"} >= 0) and (node_xpu_memutil{environment="xpu-pd",job="xpu-hardware",node=~"$node",devid=~"$device",node=~"$role"} <= 100) and (time() - timestamp(node_xpu_memutil{environment="xpu-pd",job="xpu-hardware",node=~"$node",devid=~"$device",node=~"$role"}) < 15) and (count_over_time(node_xpu_memutil{environment="xpu-pd",job="xpu-hardware",node=~"$node",devid=~"$device",node=~"$role"}[$__interval]) >= ($__interval / 5)) and on(job,instance,environment) ((up{environment="xpu-pd",job="xpu-hardware",node=~"$node",node=~"$role"} == 1) and (time() - timestamp(up{environment="xpu-pd",job="xpu-hardware",node=~"$node",node=~"$role"}) < 15) and (min_over_time(up{environment="xpu-pd",job="xpu-hardware",node=~"$node",node=~"$role"}[$__interval]) == 1) and (count_over_time(up{environment="xpu-pd",job="xpu-hardware",node=~"$node",node=~"$role"}[$__interval]) >= ($__interval / 5))))
